title: RAS Geography Chapter 1: 4 Physical Divisions of Rajasthan & Aravalli Formations
summary: Exhaustive geospatial guide covering the Western Sandy Desert (Thar), Aravalli Range (Guru Shikhar 1,722m), Eastern Plains (56 Basin), and Hadoti Plateau...

blocks.content:
### 🏔️ The 4 Physical Physiographic Divisions of Rajasthan

1. **Western Sandy Desert (Thar Desert - Marusthali):**
   • **Area & Population:** Covers **61.11% of state area**; houses **40% of state population** (12 desert districts).
   • **Rainfall:** Less than (25	ext{ cm}) annual rainfall; characterized by sand dunes (*Barchans, Longitudinal, Transverse*).
   • **Lathi Series:** Geohydrological fossil aquifer belt in Jaisalmer rich in *Sevan grass* (Lasiurus scindicus).
   • **Akal Wood Fossil Park:** 180-million-year-old Jurassic fossils in Jaisalmer.
2. **Aravalli Mountain Range (Relict Fold Mountains):**
   • **Age & Extent:** World's oldest fold mountain range (Pre-Cambrian era, (sim 650	ext{ Million Years})); runs **692 km from Khedbrahma (Gujarat) to Raisina Hill (Delhi)**; **550 km ((80%)) lies in Rajasthan** (Khetri in Jhunjhunu to Khedbrahma in Sirohi).
   • **Area & Population:** Covers **9.0% of state area**; houses **10% of population**.
   • **Top Peak Heights (Descending Sequence):**
     1. **Guru Shikhar:** **1,722 meters** (Sirohi - Mount Abu, "Colonel Todd called it *Santoon Ka Shikhar* / Peak of the Saints").
     2. **Ser:** **1,597 meters** (Sirohi).
     3. **Dilwara:** **1,442 meters** (Sirohi).
     4. **Jarga:** **1,431 meters** (Udaipur).
     5. **Achalgarh:** **1,380 meters** (Sirohi).
     6. **Kumbhalgarh:** **1,224 meters** (Rajsamand).
3. **Eastern Plains (Purvi Maidan):**
   • **Area:** **23.03% of state area**; houses **39% of population** (highest population density).
   • **Chappan Basin (Chappan Ka Maidan):** Formed by the Mahi River and its 56 village streams between Banswara and Pratapgarh.
4. **South-Eastern Plateau (Hadoti Plateau):**
   • **Area:** **6.86% of state area**; houses **11% of population**; volcanic black regur basalt soil; drained by the Chambal and its tributaries (Kali Sindh, Parbati).

🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — RPSC RAS Top Traps:
1. **Aravalli Length Split:** Total length = 692 km; Length in Rajasthan = **550 km (80%)**.
2. **50 cm Isohyet Line:** The Aravalli range aligns with the **50 cm rainfall isohyet line**, dividing Rajasthan into two distinct climatic zones (Arid/Semi-Arid West vs Sub-Humid/Humid East)!
